answer: Each agent stakes reputation on a trellis of past transactions, where one violet flag from a verified peer raises your ridge of influence but one exposed sybil collapses all linked stakes to zero. A rational attacker gains cheap extra votes, yet faces ruin: forging identities costs real collateral, and any flagged twin burns the whole cluster. So he mints fewer identities, or none. Equilibrium: identity scarcity priced by stake, sybils unprofitable.
